title: SOMA Auth: verify LinkedIn app with Minds Aligned
_note: Products cannot be added until a Page admin verifies the app's association with the LinkedIn Page. Mike is the Minds Aligned admin, so he approves his own request.

steps.instruction: LinkedIn wants the app verified by the Minds Aligned page before it adds sign-in. Click Verify next to Minds Aligned.
Click Generate URL, then open the link it shows (you are the Page admin). On that page click Verify. Then come back to this tab.
